The '''Guild of Non-Human Skilled Laborers''' was a labor guild that was formed by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Kijo Mnuue]], to oppose the way that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tried to marginalize non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] workers at the [[Tallaani Shipyards]]. Mnuue was appointed to be the [[President/Legends|President]] of the guild.
